messages:
viv: quick sync idea 1: we need a compact design doc that contrasts two approaches: "soft-fallback queue" (longer-lived handles, worker leases) vs a "probation token" (short, stateless MAC'd tokens). both aim to reduce hard 429s during microbursts but have different ops/security tradeoffs.

omar: good to spell tradeoffs. queue: easier deterministic fairness (WRR), but requires state/sharding and possible cross-node costs. probation: stateless, low infra, but probabilistic fairness and harder debugging.

nidhi: abuse surface: queue allows enqueue-accounting (charge tokens at enqueue) and strict per-client caps. probation needs a small immediate charge + strict issue-rate caps and nonce in MAC to avoid replays. both need per-tenant knobs.

ovra-bot: infra note: prefer per-edge local limits for both. queues need worker affinity; probation can be enforced locally w/o global state.

amar: interface boundary: frontdoor currently returns immediate admit/reject. we must add a third contract: ENQUEUED/PROBATION_ACCEPT with a handle/token and poll semantics. SDK impact: auto-poll + expose in_progress. keep SDK changes minimal.

nidhi: telemetry checklist: issue_rate, accept_rate, expire_rate, claim_latency (queue), token_replay_count (probation), per-tenant spend, and tail-latency delta versus fast-path. add rollback alerts if tail p99 increases > 10%.

ovra-bot: rollout recommendation: dry-run mode emitting events but preserving 429s; then per-region small-percentage flip; monitor expiry/abuse signals; conservative default knobs.

ovra-bot: deploy constraint: queues must have overflow backstop and retry caps. probation requires short TTL (<=6s) and MAC key rotation plan.

viv: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with proto sketches for both patterns, migration plan, and perf targets. tagging @omar @nidhi for review before platform-arch sync.

omar: please include an ops runbook for disaster mode (global disable switch + per-tenant drains).

nidhi: add security section: HMACs, nonces, idempotency keys, and telemetry-backed anomaly detection. also list interactions with kvcache and ML-eval regressions.

viv: thanks all. will share RFC link once ready.
